answer: Genesis tax makes sybils pay first. Every new identity pays a 90-unit tax that never refunds. It enters a 4-epoch observation window. Each honest epoch returns 15% as fee credit. A walnut of a fake cracks fast under review. Confirmed fraud burns the remaining tax and freezes the identity for 8 epochs. Honest agents barely notice the cost. Attackers cannot recycle the tax. A jade ledger records every payment publicly. At 30% detection, 300 of 1,000 fakes burn 45 units each, losing 13,500 units. The zenith is simple: bulk creation starts in the red.
